title: A Comprehensive Way to Access Hospital Death Prediction Model for Acute Mesenteric Ischemia: A Combination of Traditional Statistics and Machine Learning
summary: Traditional regression and ML models predicted hospital death in 338 acute mesenteric ischemia MIMIC-III patients; best ML validation AUC 0.829. Retrospective single-database validation only.
ai_technology: Machine-learning and traditional regression models predict hospital death from acute mesenteric ischemia records.
